competency_fulfillment.rationale: Every sampled item hands the student a set of already-built sequences and asks which one is correct, e.g. 'Which sequence correctly creates it?' with options like 'e, d, c, d, e, d' as distractors; the competency's verb is 'Create repeating patterns', which calls for the student to build the sequence, not select the one someone else already built.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Two-unit patterns ('p, c') and three-unit patterns ('19, 17, 9') are both generated, and both letters and numbers serve as the repeating unit, matching the range the competency text names.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The four-option recognition format keeps the reasoning load light, appropriate for a first encounter with pattern construction at this grade and quarter.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only mcq and cloze recognition formats appear across the sample; nothing here has the student place or arrange units directly, so the construction side of 'create' has no distinct task shape of its own in this set.

competency_alignment.rationale: Distractors break the pattern at a single position (e.g. 'e, d, e, d, e, b') rather than testing an unrelated skill, so recognizing the break still exercises pattern understanding.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Pattern units stay within small numbers and single letters throughout, matching what this grade and quarter already handles for repeating patterns.
